messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: autorun Deducer
parts:
Try the following:

open Rprofile.site with notepad. It should be located in the directory: C:\Program Files\R\R-x.x.x\etc

then add:

local({
old <- getOption("defaultPackages")
options(defaultPackages = c(old, "Deducer"))
})

If you are using JGR, simply open the package manager, and click "default" next to Deducer
